sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Where you are signed in right now. A session ends after 24 hours without use and after 7 days at the latest.
sessions.endOthersText: Every session but this one ends at once. Whoever was signed in there must sign in again.

reauth.title: Sign in again
reauth.hint: An account at {{name}} is another way into your account. Confirm that it is you first.
reauth.noPassword: Without a password: sign out and sign in again through your provider; for 10 minutes after that you can link without a password.
